lines.text: Nia Thompson
From:
To:
BrightPath Analytics HR
Internship fair follow-up
Subject:
Dear BrightPath Team,
Thanks for speaking with me yesterday about your summer analyst program.
The hardware design, marketing analytics, cybersecurity, and data storytelling
tracks each offer valuable opportunities not available at other companies.
Storytelling particularly attracts me, since my communications minor would
help me present findings to nontechnical audiences.
Per your request,I have attached my portfolio of data visualization
dashboards and case studies. I am available for virtual interviews on most
weekday mornings and can start work in June after final exams. I would also
be glad to complete coding assessments to demonstrate the skills that I
would bring to BrightPath from my computer science major.
Please let me know what the next steps are, and when you need transcripts
and a reference letter from my advisor. Thanks again for visiting campus and
engaging with students.
Best regards,
Nia
